question: Which candidates in an active process have a non-compete of six months or more, grouped by client?
sql: SELECT cl.name AS client, c.name AS candidate, r.title AS role, a.stage AS stage, c.non_compete_months AS non_compete_months, c.current_employer AS current_employer FROM applications a JOIN candidates c ON c.id = a.candidate_id JOIN roles r ON r.id = a.role_id JOIN clients cl ON cl.id = r.client_id WHERE a.status = 'active' AND c.non_compete_months >= 6 ORDER BY cl.name, c.non_compete_months DESC, c.name LIMIT 200
answer: Seven candidates in active processes have a non-compete of six months or more. At Brackenvane Trading there are three: Ewan Fairley (12 months, second round), Chloe Adeyemi (6 months, final round) and Grace Holloway (6 months, first round). At Fernhallow Capital there are four, all with 6 months: Mei Lin Tan (final round), Rohan Mehta (offer), Ruth Abernethy (submitted) and Wei Zhang (second round).

meta.note: Active applications (status = 'active') for candidates with non_compete_months >= 6, listed grouped by client name (ordered by client, then longest non-compete).
